other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022, see section 106A(3) of the Taxes Management Act 1970; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 106A(2) of that Act and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
